Timeseries Plots

Flag = 0, 1, 2 : EP Flag Flag = 3 : Absolute Limits Filter Flag = 4 : Rolling MAD Filter Flag = 5 : Diagnostic filter

CO2

CO2 is cleaned with absolute limits of 8 & -15, and a limit of 3 MADs away from the mean over a 7 day window

  "co2_flux",

)

##### Plot Builder Functions

Year to Date H and LE

# Sensible and latent heat fluxes stacked
p_H <- plot_flux_single(df, flux_col = "H.c",
                        y_label = "H (W/m²)",
                        title = "Sensible Heat Flux (H)",
                        color = "firebrick",
                        smooth = T)
                  
        

p_LE <- plot_flux_single(df, flux_col = "LE.c",
                         y_label = "LE (W/m²)",
                         title = "Latent Heat Flux (LE)",
                         color = "dodgerblue",
                         smooth = T)
                        
         

p_H / p_LE  # stack using patchwork

# Monthly H and LE

p_H_mo <- plot_flux_single(df_month, flux_col = "H.c",
                           y_label = "H (W/m²)",
                           title = "Sensible Heat Flux (H)",
                           color = "firebrick",
                           date_breaks = "2 days",
                           date_labels = "%b %d")

p_LE_mo <- plot_flux_single(df_month, flux_col = "LE.c",
                            y_label = "LE (W/m²)",
                            title = "Latent Heat Flux (LE)",
                            color = "dodgerblue",
                            date_breaks = "2 days",
                            date_labels = "%b %d")

p_H_mo / p_LE_mo

#Year to Date Longwave Radiation

p_lw <- plot_flux_long(df,
                       cols = c("LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c", "LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c"),
                       labels = c("Incoming LW", "Outgoing LW"),
                       colors = c("firebrick", "dodgerblue"),
                       y_label = expression(Longwave~Radiation~(W/m^2)),
                       title = "Longwave Radiation In/Out",
                       date_breaks = "1 month",
                       date_labels = "%b",
                       smooth = T)
p_lw

                             title = "PAR — In",
                             color = "forestgreen",

                             date_labels = "%b",
                             smooth = T)

                              y_label = expression(PAR~"(µmol m"^-2~" s"^-1*")"),
                              title = "PAR — Out",
                              color = "forestgreen",
                              date_breaks = "1 month",
                              date_labels = "%b",
                              smooth = T)

p_par_IN / p_par_OUT

# PRECIP (RAIN)

Year to Date Wind

df_wind_openair <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(wind_dir) & !is.na(WS_16_33_1_1_1)) %>%
  rename(
    wd = wind_dir,
    ws = WS_16_33_1_1_1
  )

windRose(df_wind_openair,
         ws = "ws",
         wd = "wd",
         paddle = FALSE,
         key = TRUE,
         main = "Wind Rose")

# Monthly Wind

df_wind_openair <- df_month %>%
  filter(!is.na(wind_dir) & !is.na(WS_16_33_1_1_1)) %>%
  rename(
    wd = wind_dir,
    ws = WS_16_33_1_1_1
  )

windRose(df_wind_openair,
         ws = "ws",
         wd = "wd",
         paddle = FALSE,
         key = TRUE,
         main = "Wind Rose")
